selector: unchanged distributed.py policy, seed and original packet/unit domain; one position per 16 original indices before admission
case_state: separate calibration/testing histograms and absorbing detection history for each case; shared selector does not pool cases
calibration: current-prefix reserved samples only; pilot excluded; pooled 100 original quantiles with inclusive ties
testing: admissible nonreserved samples; recompute entire current-prefix crops when thresholds move
inference: positive-variance Welch and certified Student tail at frozen binary64 t/df; no old-population sparse inference on replacement crops
multiplicity: replace crops, never OR with original crops; original decisions retained separately; 21*102*8 family unchanged
failures: missing/reordered/future/mismatched prefix, numeric unresolved, resource limit and integrity failure are never nondetection
model_limit: sample separation does not establish temporal independence, exchangeability, Welch approximation validity or real-clock sensitivity
deployment: separately identified local collector candidate; no physical or CI adoption
